claims.claim: You must provide details of the person you care for.
claims.quote: details of the person you care for, including their National Insurance number, if you know it
claims.note: The application page requests these details before applying.

claims.claim: You must provide proof of your caring role and the hours you care.
claims.quote: We might also need to ask them to confirm that you care for them.
claims.note: Social Security Scotland may confirm the caring role with the person cared for, but the supplied text does not require applicants to submit proof of hours.
